description: This is a shell script (.sh) file named DCMscript.sh that performs configuration management, network checks, and telemetry reporting in an embedded device or router environment. It includes functions for network status checks, configuration retrieval via HTTP, recovery mechanisms, and conditional execution based on system state and build types.

methods.name: getFWVersion
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version from /version.txt by parsing the imagename field.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Returns the build type for the system, based on environment variables.

methods.name: getECMMacAddress
methods.description: Gets the ECM MAC address by invoking getECMMac, stripping whitespace and quotes.

methods.name: getReceiverId
methods.description: Reads the Receiver ID from a specific device data file if available.

methods.name: getChannelMapId
methods.description: Returns a static Channel Map ID.

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Checks if direct connection attempts are blocked based on a timestamp file.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Determine whether Codebig is available and enabled, sets connection parameters accordingly.

methods.name: useDirectRequest
methods.description: Attempts to perform a direct network request with retries, respects blocking conditions.

methods.name: useCodebigRequest
methods.description: Performs a Codebig network request with retries, signing requests as needed.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Processes the JSON response from server into a formatted configuration.

methods.name: sendHttpRequestToServer
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with curl, retries on failure, and handles HTTP response codes.

methods.name: dropbearRecovery
methods.description: Checks if dropbear SSH is running; attempts to restart it if missing.

methods.name: t2Log
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp to a specific log file.
